description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is an urgent opportunity for a visionary nursing leader to make a significant impact on patient care and operational excellence. We are looking to fill this role promptly.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the delivery of high-quality patient care, and maintaining compliance with all state and federal regulations. This position offers a chance to shape the future of nursing services and foster a supportive and professional environment for both staff and residents.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Proven experience as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing in a skilled nursing facility setting.
Comprehensive understanding of state and federal long-term care regulations.
Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills.
